questions.question: What woe does Isaiah 31 pronounce?
options: Woe to the proud prophets who speak lies in my name
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses
Woe to those who grind down the very faces of the poor in the dust
Woe to the city that is full of bloodshed and deceit
questions.answer: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses

questions.question: How are the Egyptians contrasted with God in Isaiah 31?
options: They are very many, while the people of Israel are few
They are man, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit
They are exceedingly wise, while the people of Israel are foolish
They are very rich, while the people of Israel are poor
questions.answer: They are man, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit

questions.question: Isaiah 31 says the LORD of hosts will protect Jerusalem like birds hovering over it.
Woe to those who go down to _____ for help and rely on horses.
